A woman sues for thousands in pain and suffering when her contractor turns out to be a handyman with no license who refuses to refund her after a botched attempt at asbestos removal.

title: Justice for the People With Judge Milian

S04 E39 — Signed, Slipped, Delivered & Pressure Point
A delivery driver blames a homeowner when he slips on an icy driveway and hurts his shoulder; a woman seeks damages after she was injured by an aggressive massage.

title: Justice for the People With Judge Milian

S03 E100 — Imprisoned Parkers & Family Keepsake
A car is towed when the owner leaves the vehicle at a parking structure after hours; cousins argue over money from the sale of an heirloom chest.
